responsibility: Implements the core Alpha target backend: option override logic, target hook definitions, calling convention and varargs handling, prologue/epilogue generation, address legitimacy and reload support, constant/materialization logic, move expansion including unaligned and floating variants, builtin expansion and folding, atomic operation splitting, reorg and scheduling cost logic, assembler operand printing, and Alpha-specific RTL passes such as trap-shadow handling and instruction alignment. It is the main executable body that consumes GCC RTL/tree state and target options and produces Alpha-specific RTL expansions, assembler syntax decisions, ABI behavior, and hook results used throughout code generation.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the Alpha stem: it contains the executable backend logic and target hook definitions that act on GCC IR and cooperate with patterns in alpha.md, unlike alpha.h which declares machine properties/macros and alpha.opt which only declares -m option parsing metadata.
